exposure: gestational weight gain (total, before OGTT, after OGTT)
gestational weight gain categories (inadequate, normal, excessive)
cohort: The study included 2190 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and 10,817 women without GDM.
finding: The associations of gestational weight gain with pregnancy outcomes, particularly after the oral glucose tolerance test, differed significantly based on gestational diabetes mellitus status.
mod_finding: Increasing gestational weight gain rate at each period and excessive gestational weight gain during any period were associated with higher risks of cesarean delivery in both women with and without GDM.
